pages.text:
The rift closed behind you three days ago. That is what it does -- opens, puts
somebody down in this courtyard, closes again. You have been asleep since.

This is Ennara, and Ennara is what is still standing. You are Blessed, which is
the polite word for two shapes and no instructions. Neither of those is your
fault, and neither of them is going away.

options.text: Then tell me what to do.

pages.text:
Two shapes. Human Form and Animal Form, and you will be switching between them
for the rest of your life.

Human Form is identical for every one of us -- no gift, no trait, nothing inherited.
Animal Form is where whatever you are actually shows itself, and it is not a
choice you get to make twice.

Which one you carry is already decided. You will find out what it costs you soon
enough.

The fourth kingdom, and the only capital still taking arrivals. The other three
have their own walls and their own coin and their own opinions about the rift.

You are standing in the courtyard. Market north, guild south of that, harbour east
where the water is. The gate out is on the south road, and there is a sentry on it
who will want your name before you use it.

The same thing every Blessed does first. You go and be seen by the one who carries
your shape.

They are all here, all around this courtyard, and they have all been waiting on
somebody. Whether they admit to waiting is a matter of temperament.

pages.text:
The God of the Hunt. North side of the courtyard -- you will know them when you see them.

Go and be seen. Whatever happens after that is between the two of you.
